main_text.head: VVOLFGANGVS VVOLLENSCHLEGERVS: Oh, fulge longus, ceu vernus Gallus.
main_text.p: GAllus nuncius est amoenus alma Lucis: sidera gloriosa sentit: Quacunque excubat in domo, popello Suo pennigero imperat: triumfans, Si vincat, canit, atque principem se Testatur, rutilam erigendo cristam: Visu territat & trucem leonem. Hæc VVOLFGANGE, tibi omnia applicantur: Lucis nuncius es serenus almæ, Dum quæ filia lucis est, rotundo Profers ore subinde veritatem: Sentis sidera gloriosa, cœli Dum mysteria sempiterna sentis: In quocunque loco, domi foris-ve Sedes imperium asseris paterna Gentis, ingenio expolitiore: Vincendo canis, & canendo vincis, Quot sunt, quotque fuere Musicorum Omnes; quis merito queas levare Donis, ingenuo rubore cristas: Ob quæ ringat amarus ipse Satan, Leo maximus invidissimusque. His virtutibus, hisce gratiisque FVLGE OH LONGVS in optima, ampla secla: GALLVS vivere CEV solet creatus VERE longior: elegantiorum O virûm alter Apollo Musicorum!

page.notes: Marginal text at left is faint and not legible; not transcribed. Several words are doubtful in the verse (e.g. "cristam", "lucis", "canis") and the scan is slightly blurred; "Vincendo canis" may be "cantis" in print. Long s rendered as s throughout.
